steps.name: Navigate to Login or Sign Up Page
Register locator handler getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept All Cookies' })
Verify error message for empty email
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Email or phone number is required', { exact: true })
Expect "toHaveText" getByText('Email or phone number is required', { exact: true })
